# xmatters_person (Resource)

Create or update a user in xMatters.

When adding new users, you must assign at least one role to a new user and you may optionally assign one or more supervisors. The supervisors must have permission to supervise users and the authenticating account must have permission to assign supervisors. If you do not assign a supervisor then the authenticating account becomes the user's supervisor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Basic:
resource "xmatters_person" "basic_create" {
  target_name  = "mmcbride"
  web_login    = "mmcbride"
  first_name   = "Margot"
  last_name    = "McBride"
  roles        = ["Full Access User"]
  timezone     = "US/Pacific"
  language     = "en"
  license_type = "FULL_USER"
  site         = "1d7505ce-8d50-411d-9d6e-8cfbc365b5fe"
  supervisors  = []
}

// Advanced:
resource "xmatters_person" "advanced_person" {
  target_name = "mmcbride"
  first_name  = "Margot"
  last_name   = "McBride"
  roles = [
    "Developer",
    "Full Access User"
  ]
  status    = "ACTIVE"
  web_login = "mmcbride@your-company.org"
  site      = "1d7505ce-8d50-411d-9d6e-8cfbc365b5fe"
  timezone  = "US/Pacific"
  language  = "en"
  supervisors = [
    "481086d8-357a-4279-b7d5-d7dce48fcd12",
    "545686d8-3491-4a12-ddb7-a33239e82bc7"
  ]
  phone_login      = "123456789"
  phone_pin        = "9728"
  license_type     = "FULL_USER"
  external_key     = "c5aa0fff0a0a0aa7009a39da035ea396"
  externally_owned = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `language` (String) Preferred language of the user. The language must already be enabled in your xMatters instance.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `license_type` (String) xMatters user license type. Available options are: FULL_USER, STAKEHOLDER_USER. Default is FULL_USER.
- `roles` (Set of String) Comma-separated list of xMatters role names to assign to the user.
- `site` (String) Unique ID of the site in your xMatters instance the user is assigned to. If a value is not provided, the site of the authenticating user is assigned.
- `supervisors` (Set of String) Comma-separated list of unique identifiers (UUID) that represent the user's supervisors. Supervisors must have the role-based permissions required to supervise the user and the authenticating account must have permission to assign supervisors to the user. If empty or null, the user will have no supervisors. If the property is omitted from the request, the authenticating user who makes the request is set as the supervisor.
- `target_name` (String) User ID in xMatters. A combination of letters and numbers is permitted with a maximum value of 100 characters. For example, a target name for Mary McBride  could be  'mmcbride' or 'mcbride2418'.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone where the user is located. The time zone must already be enabled in your xMatters instance.
- `web_login` (String) Identifier used to log in to the xMatters web user interface. If a value is not set in the request, the value of the target_name field is used. This field has  a maximum of 100 characters.

### Optional

- `external_key` (String) Unique identifier of a resource in an external system.
- `externally_owned` (Boolean) Whether the object is managed by an external system. Available options are: true, false. Default value is false'.
- `phone_login` (String) An access code for the user to identify themselves when they phone into xMatters to retrieve messages. The phone login has a maximum length of 30 characters and must only contain digits. You can also set an optional phone PIN for the user.
- `phone_pin` (String, Sensitive) Used with phone_login, the optional PIN a user enters to identify themselves when they phone into xMatters to retrieve messages. The PIN has a maximum length of 30 characters and must only contain digits. Once submitted in the request, the phone PIN is not returned or displayed in the response object.
- `status` (String) Status of the user in xMatters. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Default is ACTIVE.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters user.
- `last_updated` (String)
